name: Example Small Molecule Discovery
description: Example portfolio on synthetic data. Its registry has no stage, so gate decisions are made and recorded in the portal.

programDatasets.name: Assay results
programDatasets.description: One row per compound and assay run: the measurements the SAR table summarizes. Synthetic.

stageModel.name: Example Small Molecule Discovery
stageModel.description: Target validation through preclinical candidate. Criteria are mostly data conditions on the lead set.

criteria.name: ≥1 validated series with SAR
criteria.rule: ≥1 series at validated maturity or beyond with ≥3 compounds

criteria.name: ADME panel on ≥10 lead-series compounds
criteria.rule: solubility, permeability (Papp) and clearance (CLint) on ≥10 lead-set compounds

criteria.name: hERG IC50 ≥ 10 µM on a lead-set compound
criteria.rule: hERG IC50 ≥ 10 µM on ≥1 lead-set compound

feeds.sql:
WITH reg(code, status, target, therapeutic_area) AS (VALUES
    ('EXS-KIN1', 'ACTIVE', 'Kinase K1', 'Oncology'),
    ('EXS-PRO2', 'ACTIVE', 'Protease P2', 'Immunology'),
    ('EXS-GPC3', 'ACTIVE', 'GPCR G3', 'Neuroscience'),
    ('EXS-ION4', 'INACTIVE', 'Ion channel C4', 'Neuroscience'),
    ('EXS-EPI5', 'ACTIVE', 'Bromodomain B5', 'Oncology'))
SELECT code, code AS name, status, 'Small Molecule' AS modality, target, therapeutic_area FROM reg
